entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had only ever seen members of the..."
entries.dialogueText: I had only ever seen members of the Royal Council in this room before. Today, though, it was packed with military staff. Every single top-ranking general and admiral in Rizia was in attendance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's cut the chit-chat and start..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's cut the chit-chat and start with this."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as I entered the room, they..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as I entered the room, they stopped their chatter and saluted me. Everyone, except for one man in a wheelchair, General Taddeus Azaro, stood up.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At ease, soldiers.""
entries.dialogueText: "At ease, soldiers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I saluted."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I arrived at the Council Chambers t..."
entries.dialogueText: I arrived at the Council Chambers to discuss our war plans with the highest-ranking members of the Rizian military.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were standing over a massive t..."
entries.dialogueText: They were standing over a massive table, arranging golden and silver tokens atop a map of Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita rushed to my side."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita rushed to my side.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duchess Azaro.""
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you ready?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you ready?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The General looked much the same as..."
entries.dialogueText: The General looked much the same as he had at the football game some months ago.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I tried to summon memories of him a..."
entries.dialogueText: I tried to summon memories of him as my father's war councilor. It was hard to reconcile that authoritative, energetic figure with the frail old man before me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I tried to summon memories of servi..."
entries.dialogueText: I tried to summon memories of serving alongside him on my father's council. It was hard to reconcile that authoritative, energetic figure with the frail old man before me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I tried to summon memories of my ti..."
entries.dialogueText: I tried to summon memories of my time serving beneath him in the military. It was hard to reconcile that authoritative, energetic figure with the frail old man before me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I locked eyes with Taddeus. He salu..."
entries.dialogueText: I locked eyes with Taddeus. He saluted me with a trembling hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I saluted him back. He moved his li..."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted him back. He moved his lips wordlessly, then finally spoke.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone in the room returned the s..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone in the room returned the salute with full force.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As the highest-ranking officer in..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the highest-ranking officer in the Rizian Armed Forces and an unmatched expert in military strategy, I invited my father to join us today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Welcome back, General Azaro.""
entries.dialogueText: "Welcome back, General Azaro."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""It's good to be back, Lieutenant.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's good to be back, Lieutenant."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Shall we start, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "Shall we start, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please proceed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I nodded in approval."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded in approval.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. What are we even waiting for?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. What are we even waiting for?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, our forces are alrea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, our forces are already mobilized. Our navy and air forces are prepared and awaiting your orders. And our ground forces will be ready to cross the border within 48 hours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is our intelligence regarding..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is our intelligence regarding Pales' defenses?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what is the plan for the initi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what is the plan for the initial strike?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Okay. What are our options?""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay. What are our options?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our intelligence suggests Pales ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our intelligence suggests Pales may not be completely prepared for an immediate incursion. We have the element of surprise, which we should capitalize on."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our intelligence suggests Pales is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our intelligence suggests Pales is expecting an immediate incursion."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""However, they have been strengthen..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, they have been strengthening their northern border with us -- building forts and bunkers along the River Alca."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They have been strengthening their..."
entries.dialogueText: "They have been strengthening their northern border with us -- building forts and bunkers along the River Alca."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We also received intelligence abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "We also received intelligence about the deployment of dozens of high-tech armored vehicles with unknown capabilities -- which we believe to be of Lespian origin."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We believe they've recently receiv..."
entries.dialogueText: "We believe they've recently received dozens of tanks of Lespian origin as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pointed at the Antacean Sea on..."
entries.dialogueText: She pointed at the Antacean Sea on the map.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""According to our intelligence, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to our intelligence, they have already called the ships that were blockading the Aureus field back to the Palesian coasts."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Unfortunately, due to their recent..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, due to their recent acquisition of a large number of Lespian destroyers, their navy is more than capable of breaking our blockade attempts."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The general staff proposes a two-p..."
entries.dialogueText: "The general staff proposes a two-pronged attack. First, we'll need to block Palesian ports, crippling their trade and preventing the Grand Duchy from receiving any external support."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Second, we'll mount a large ground..."
entries.dialogueText: "Second, we'll mount a large ground offensive aimed at securing key border defenses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So, this is what we'll do...""
entries.dialogueText: "So, this is what we'll do..."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Speed is of the essence. We must o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Speed is of the essence. We must overwhelm Palesian soldiers before they can fully mobilize."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""However, an assault from the north..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, an assault from the north --particularly across the Alca -- would come at a high cost, as it remains their most heavily fortified border."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""However, an assault from the north..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, an assault from the north would be a tough endeavor, especially given the difficulties of crossing the Alca."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Unfortunately, due to their recent..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, due to their recent acquisition of a large number of Lespian destroyers, their navy is more than capable of breaking our blockade attempts."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And according to reports, they are..."
entries.dialogueText: "And according to reports, they are already deploying thousands of soldiers along their entire border at this moment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Okay. Let's talk about our deploym..."
entries.dialogueText: "Okay. Let's talk about our deployment and general strategy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we attack from the north, we co..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we attack from the north, we could catch them by surprise. They wouldn't expect us to lead a grand offensive on their most fortified border."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do the generals suggest?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do the generals suggest?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How about striking from their west..."
entries.dialogueText: "How about striking from their western border?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Our proposal is to feign an attack..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our proposal is to feign an attack in the north to make them focus their forces there, but to spread our forces throughout the border."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""This strategy would allow us to st..."
entries.dialogueText: "This strategy would allow us to strike from the west."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We could feign an attack in the no..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could feign an attack in the north to drawn their forces there, while we concentrate the majority of our forces in the west."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""However, their western border is c..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, their western border is covered with mountains. And we believe they possess specially trained mountaineer units defending that terrain."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""There is a chance we can break thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a chance we can break through from their southern coast with the help of our navy."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""If we can deploy our armored units..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we can deploy our armored units on that front, we can push from their coast and block their supply lines."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""It is indeed one of our options.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is indeed one of our options."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What would attacking from the nort..."
entries.dialogueText: "What would attacking from the north entail?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We would deploy our armored forces..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would deploy our armored forces around Fort Ales and focus our attack on Navar."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If we get Navar quickly, we can mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we get Navar quickly, we can move towards Arces and cut the supply lines for their whole army."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""However, initiating an attack from..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, initiating an attack from Fort Ales would put our city at great risk. And we have to be quick enough for them not to focus their forces in the north."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can also focus on a naval invas..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can also focus on a naval invasion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I like the idea to feign an attack..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like the idea to feign an attack from the north to split their forces."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think this is the strategy they..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think this is the strategy they would least expect."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think we shouldn't risk anything..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we shouldn't risk anything with a fake assault."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm afraid with our current capabi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid with our current capabilities, it is not possible to initiate a massive naval invasion."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our specially trained marines can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our specially trained marines can definitely open an additional front from the south, but due to our capacity, it would be a quite limited assault."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm afraid with our current capabi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid with our current capabilities, it is not possible to initiate any meaningful naval invasion."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Although our navy could potentiall..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although our navy could potentially support our land units in the south, we do not possess the capability to carry enough troops for a successful landing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What would attacking from the nort..."
entries.dialogueText: "What would attacking from the north entail?"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Taddeus Azaro: ""We would deploy our armored forces..."]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I'm with you on that, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm with you on that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If they do not possess our deploym..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they do not possess our deployment plans, that might force them to keep a balanced defense throughout their border."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I suspect that to be the case as w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suspect that to be the case as well, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As the King, you have total contro..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the King, you have total control over our military strategy and the deployment of our troops."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""However, I've prepared a briefing..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I've prepared a briefing that will help inform your decisions. Would you like to hear it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I already know everything.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. I already know everything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please, General.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please, General."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""What would you like to hear about..."
entries.dialogueText: "What would you like to hear about first?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room fell into a silence as eve..."
entries.dialogueText: The room fell into a silence as everybody looked at me in anticipation of what I would say next.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty. As the King, you hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. As the King, you have total control over our military strategy and the deployment of our troops."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "General Taddeus cut in."
entries.dialogueText: General Taddeus cut in.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But before you give the orders, wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But before you give the orders, would you like to hear about the status of our military and the options the generals outlined?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go ahead, General.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go ahead, General."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I already know everything, Gen..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I already know everything, General. I'm ready to give you your orders, so listen carefully."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not interrupt me ever again.""
entries.dialogueText: "Do not interrupt me ever again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His face contorted in silent anger,..."
entries.dialogueText: His face contorted in silent anger, but he refrained from responding to me and bowed his head.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Of course, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's the status of our military?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's the status of our military?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are our strategic objectives?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are our strategic objectives?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Due to the extensive Palesian nava..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to the extensive Palesian naval defenses around Pales and the Gulf of Ales -- as well as the possibility of direct engagement with Lespia -- our strategy will have to rely on an attack from either the north or the southwest."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Our first objective is to take con..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our first objective is to take control of the cities of Ziqes and Arces and trap their forces at the chokepoint at Solles."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Give me the details of each front..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give me the details of each front and what to expect."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think I have enough information.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think I have enough information."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will lead a direct assault with..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will lead a direct assault without any precursors. It is better if they spread their defenses without a clear focus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before the invasion, we will feign..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before the invasion, we will feign an attack from the north and try to get their forces to focus there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before the invasion, we will feign..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before the invasion, we will feign an attack from the south and try to get their forces to focus there."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The generals in the room gave me a..."
entries.dialogueText: The generals in the room gave me a military salute while shouting "Yes, sir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will look into it in detail, Gen..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will look into it in detail, General."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""In light of this, I'd like to send..."
entries.dialogueText: "In light of this, I'd like to send you a detailed plan for our initial deployment through the border -- focusing on a simultaneous attack toward Ziqes and the southwestern coast."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No offense, general, but I'll plan..."
entries.dialogueText: "No offense, general, but I'll plan the assault and the deployment of our forces personally."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot, and will not, oversee ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot, and will not, oversee every division or the entire war effort. I will grant full authority for the invasion to the General Staff and to you, General Azaro."
entries.menuText: "I cannot, and will not, oversee every division or the entire war effort. I will grant full authority for the invasion to the General Staff and to you, General Azaro." [OPT OUT OF WAR GAMEPLAY]

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Understood, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Our initial operation will be aime..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our initial operation will be aimed at taking control of Arces and Ziqes."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The city of Ziqes is located very..."
entries.dialogueText: "The city of Ziqes is located very close to our borders, and it lies on the highway and railway system that runs through the middle of the country."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Due to the city's proximity to our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to the city's proximity to our borders, it is heavily defended. Unfortunately, our air forces will only be of help once we destroy their anti-air systems, which are located in the mountains south of the city."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Another strategic point is the tow..."
entries.dialogueText: "Another strategic point is the town of Navar, directly by our border near Fort Ales."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Pales also has incredibly sophisti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales also has incredibly sophisticated anti-air defenses installed in that area -- and any attack from the north would require the capture of the area for our air forces to be able to support our operation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed at the map."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed at the map.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The most important goal for our in..."
entries.dialogueText: "The most important goal for our initial operation is to capture the city of Arces, situated directly in the middle of Pales."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We have intelligence that their de..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have intelligence that their defense is organized from there and it provides supplies to every front. By cutting that city from their network, we can crush their border defenses and create a new frontline from Navar to the sea."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Furthermore, we will keep our navy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, we will keep our navy on standby until the assault begins. We cannot risk any reckless damage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Furthermore, we will immediately f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, we will immediately focus our Navy to blockade the Gulf of Ales. It is their most heavily guarded area but the closest to our coastline."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Furthermore, we will immediately f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, we will immediately focus our Navy to blockade the Gulf of Pales. Our efforts must be focused at their capital even if that means a direct confrontation with their strongest fleet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Furthermore, we will immediately f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, we will immediately focus our Navy to blockade the Gulf of Remaz. Our efforts must be focused on disrupting their trade without a risky confrontation at sea."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Understood, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will keep our navy and our mari..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will keep our navy and our marines on standby for a possible naval invasion. We cannot risk any reckless damage before the invasion begins."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""As mentioned, our ground forces ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "As mentioned, our ground forces are mobilizing as we speak, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We can field a substantial number..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can field a substantial number of infantry divisions, which are quite enough to overwhelm the Palesian forces."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We can field approximately eight t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can field approximately eight to nine fully equipped infantry divisions. This should be a solid force for our campaign against Pales.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We can field approximately six to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can field approximately six to seven fully equipped infantry divisions. Given our modest numbers, we must exercise caution, as infantry makes up the bulk of our forces."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: "We can field five fully equipped in..."
entries.dialogueText: We can field five fully equipped infantry divisions, but with Palesian infantry outnumbering us, we should proceed with caution."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Fortunately, we have a significant..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, we have a significant number of mechanized support divisions, which will prove invaluable in backing up our infantry and armored divisions during the assault."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Fortunately, we have a solid numbe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, we have a solid number of mechanized support divisions, which will provide vital assistance in supporting the infantry and armored divisions during their assaults."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""On the other hand, we also have a..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, we also have a modest number of mechanized support divisions which will be useful in supporting the assaults of our infantry and armored divisions."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Unfortunately, we can only field t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, we can only field three mechanized support divisions, each specifically trained to assist the assaults of our infantry and armored divisions.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We should not risk losing them --..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should not risk losing them -- as they can change the tide of the war."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""And lastly, when it comes to our t..."
entries.dialogueText: "And lastly, when it comes to our tanks..."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Our tank divisions outnumber Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our tank divisions outnumber Pales' and will spearhead the main assault."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We currently field enough tank div..."
entries.dialogueText: "We currently field enough tank divisions to spearhead the main assault."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I hate to say it, but Pales has fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hate to say it, but Pales has far more than we have. We can only field three tank divisions."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I hate to say it, but Pales has fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hate to say it, but Pales has far more than we have. We can barely field two tank divisions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita stepped forward."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita stepped forward.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Meanwhile, our air force stands re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, our air force stands ready to challenge Palesian control of the skies."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""On the other hand, our air force i..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, our air force is barely capable of contesting Palesian air superiority."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our admirals have reported that ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our admirals have reported that our specially trained marine divisions and their deployment ships will be ready to initiate a coastal invasion in no time."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And lastly, our navy is led by our..."
entries.dialogueText: "And lastly, our navy is led by our flagship RRN Valero."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And lastly, our navy has unfortuna..."
entries.dialogueText: "And lastly, our navy has unfortunately suffered a great loss with RRN Valero taken out of service."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It is also important to highlight..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is also important to highlight that despite the great investments Rizia has made in our navy, the Palesians still have access to superior technology."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It is also important to highlight..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is also important to highlight that while we can theoretically hold our own against the Palesian navy, they boast both superior technology and larger numbers."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Luckily, our fleets contain a larg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Luckily, our fleets contain a large number of destroyers -- which will surely help us gain superiority at sea."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our fleets also contain enough des..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our fleets also contain enough destroyers to be able to contest the Palesian navy at critical locations."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Unfortunately, we do not have enou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, we do not have enough fleets to be able to counter Palesian ships in any direct confrontation."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our submarines will also provide s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our submarines will also provide support when necessary. We have enough of them to be able to wreak havoc on Pales' ships."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our submarines will also provide s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our submarines will also provide support when necessary. Although we don't have many of them, they can still wreak havoc on Pales' ships."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""On their northern border, they hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "On their northern border, they have several heavily fortified areas across the River Alca."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed to the River Alca on our..."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed to the River Alca on our border with Pales.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""They also have sophisticated air d..."
entries.dialogueText: "They also have sophisticated air defenses placed around the town of Navar -- very close to our city, Fort Ales."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""These defenses will severely impac..."
entries.dialogueText: "These defenses will severely impact our capability to push for an assault from Fort Ales."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Their most defended position on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their most defended position on their western front is right between Rizia's Terador and the Palesian city of Ziqes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He then pointed to the border city..."
entries.dialogueText: He then pointed to the border city of Ziqes.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We suspect they may push for a cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "We suspect they may push for a counter offensive from Ziqes -- possibly with their armored divisions in the front."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""The city of Ziqes and its surround..."
entries.dialogueText: "The city of Ziqes and its surroundings are also defended by heavy air defense systems -- which we believe to be located south of the city."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""The western border features rugged..."
entries.dialogueText: "The western border features rugged mountainous terrain, effectively dividing Pales by separating the northern front from the south."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""As previously mentioned, we antici..."
entries.dialogueText: "As previously mentioned, we anticipate fierce resistance in these mountains, as we believe Pales has specialized mountaineer units stationed to defend those positions."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yes, Your Majesty. Thank you for y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. Thank you for your confidence."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We will relay your orders immediat..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will relay your orders immediately, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone in the room -- except Tadd..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone in the room -- except Taddeus -- stood up and saluted me.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I will return to you as soon as we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will return to you as soon as we have an update."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And there it was. The Invasion of P..."
entries.dialogueText: And there it was. The Invasion of Pales was about to begin.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. We've been through this alread..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. We've been through this already."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Before we begin, some news from ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we begin, some news from our Grand Admiral..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Unfortunately, the damage from the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, the damage from the attack on our flagship Valero were worse than initially reported and the ship remains out of service. We won't be able to use it in our invasion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She directed our attention to the m..."
entries.dialogueText: She directed our attention to the map on the table.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Paskal Beniwoll
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The last time I had seen the room t..."
entries.dialogueText: The last time I had seen the room this full was at the start of the Reclamation War. Now, just like then, it was packed with military staff. Every single top-ranking general and admiral in Rizia was in attendance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The people assembled in the room re..."
entries.dialogueText: The people assembled in the room relaxed their shoulders slightly, but kept their backs straight.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You remembered your form, Lieutena..."
entries.dialogueText: "You remembered your form, Lieutenant."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Good form for a civilian, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good form for a civilian, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He moved his lips wordlessly, then..."
entries.dialogueText: He moved his lips wordlessly, then finally spoke.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Glad to be of service, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glad to be of service, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You answer to me now. Don't forget..."
entries.dialogueText: "You answer to me now. Don't forget that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How is your health?""
entries.dialogueText: "How is your health?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must commend your daughter for h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must commend your daughter for her exceptional performance on the Council in your stead."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My apologies. You shouldn't have b..."
entries.dialogueText: "My apologies. You shouldn't have been dragged out of your sickbed for this."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Never, Your Majesty. I will endeav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never, Your Majesty. I will endeavor to serve you just as I served your father, God rest his soul."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Better by the day. I knew there wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Better by the day. I knew there was a reason death spared me. To help Rizia retake Pales once and for all."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I expected no less of her.""
entries.dialogueText: "I expected no less of her."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I dragged myself here, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "I dragged myself here, Your Majesty. Death spared me for a single reason: to help Rizia retake Pales once and for all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He slowly smiled as his gaze drifte..."
entries.dialogueText: He slowly smiled as his gaze drifted between the two of us. Lucita cleared her throat.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But according to reports, they are..."
entries.dialogueText: "But according to reports, they are already deploying thousands of soldiers along their entire border at this moment."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus gestured for one of his aid..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus gestured for one of his aides to bring him a pointer. He aimed it at the map.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLCText.News_RD_IncreasedLevies_PalesWar = "The resulting massive boost in manpower is sure to give us an edge in the fight to liberate Pales."
entries.userScript: Variable["RiziaDLCText.News_RD_IncreasedLevies_PalesWar"] ="The resulting massive boost in manpower is sure to give us an edge in the fight to liberate Pales.";

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita turned her attention to Gene..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita turned her attention to General Azaro.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""His ailment may have slowed his st..."
entries.dialogueText: "His ailment may have slowed his stride, but his mind remains as sharp as ever."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Standing next to them was General C..."
entries.dialogueText: Standing next to them was General Carlos Robles Azaro, the second-in-command of the Armed Forces, best known for his defense of Porte Drazon during the Uprising.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Unlike his superior, Carlos stood w..."
entries.dialogueText: Unlike his superior, Carlos stood with an air of energy and vigor, his posture straight and alert as he saluted me once more.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""General Azaro. It’s been some time.""
entries.dialogueText: "General Azaro. It’s been some time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At easy, soldier.""
entries.dialogueText: "At easy, soldier."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There he is. The man. The legend.""
entries.dialogueText: "There he is. The man. The legend."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Honored to have you here, General.""
entries.dialogueText: "Honored to have you here, General."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I saluted him back."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted him back.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gave him a slight nod."
entries.dialogueText: I gave him a slight nod.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I straightened myself slightly."
entries.dialogueText: I straightened myself slightly.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. The honor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. The honor is mine."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: "“Hardly, Your Majesty. Just a soldi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Hardly, Your Majesty. Just a soldier doing his duty.”

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Too long, Your Majesty. I'm honore..."
entries.dialogueText: "Too long, Your Majesty. I'm honored to be here."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. It's an h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. It's an honor to be here."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We can conduct bombings almost eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can conduct bombings almost everywhere outside of the reach of their primary air defense systems -- which are not insignificant to say the least."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We can still try conducting bombin..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can still try conducting bombings outside of the reach of their primary air defense systems -- which will be quite a problem."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The generals exchanged brief glance..."
entries.dialogueText: The generals exchanged brief glances, a silent confirmation passing between them.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what of our provincial House f..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what of our provincial House forces?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As for the House units themselves,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for the House units themselves, I’m proud to say that House Azaro’s forces are the best organized and excel in offensive operations."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As for House Sazon... while their..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for House Sazon... while their ability to launch sustained assaults is limited, their troops are highly organized and provide the strongest land-based logistical support."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Meanwhile, House Toras maintains a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, House Toras maintains a well-balanced force with strong defensive capabilities."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Our defensive capabilities may not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our defensive capabilities may not be as robust as some other Houses, but they are more than capable in swift, decisive strikes."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""However, like House Sazon, their o..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, like House Sazon, their offensive strength is better suited for support roles than for spearheading an attack."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thanks to your order to increase p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to your order to increase provincial levies, I’m proud to report that the size of our House army divisions has effectively doubled."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: "This policy has greatly enhanced ou..."
entries.dialogueText: This policy has greatly enhanced our military strength, providing us with both additional manpower and crucial equipment to better support our operations."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You'll be pleased to know that uni..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be pleased to know that units comprising House troops are among the most capable in the Rizian Armed Forces."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""All in all, should they face Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "All in all, should they face Palesian troops, each House will prove to be a formidable fighting force."
